title: BlackLanturn Build 1.1.51
summary: Recommended compatibility update: current addons with tested playback, tracking and saved-settings protection.

sections.heading: Compatible current addons
bullets: Reviewed Helper6.19.6 and Umbrella6.7.99 retain BlackLanturn playback, progress, search and reliability fixes.
Current Trakt, MDbList and Kodi sync providers and SkinVariables are included with exact source checks.

sections.heading: Keep accounts and preferences
bullets: MDbList migration keeps the original Helper key and any existing provider key. Its completion marker preserves a later intentional logout.
In-place updates retain accounts, settings, saved data and unrelated addons. Standard retains supported selected preferences; Clean uses build defaults.
Selected-account reinstalls preserve Floppy OAuth refresh, client and server identity alongside existing provider sign-ins.

sections.heading: Faster saved browsing
bullets: Accepted saved Home, Movies, Shows and visited-public-row improvements are included along with branded YouTube folder icons.
Tracking configuration remains under Settings, Playback & sync. First visits and expired displays still use normal providers.

sections.heading: Protected compatibility
bullets: Installer1.0.47 validates the complete current sync group before cleanup and protects reviewed addon versions against ordinary bulk updates.
Both branded icon packs and accepted platform playback differences remain included.
Explicitly disabling a Helper sync provider stays disabled instead of falling back to a previously selected legacy provider.
